{{1960 Summer Olympics}}

The [[1960 Summer Olympics]], officially known as the Games of the XVII Olympiad, were an international [[multi-sport event]] held in [[Rome]], Italy, from August 25 to September 11, 1960.<ref>{{Cite web |title=1960 Summer Olympics Overview |url=https://www.olympedia.org/editions/15 |access-date=2025-02-20 |website=[[Olympedia]] |archive-date=January 20, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250120114203/http://www.olympedia.org/editions/15 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=FAQ: What are the Olympic Games? |url=http://olympic.ca/2019/02/08/faq-what-are-the-olympic-games/ |website=[[Canadian Olympic Committee]] |date=2019-02-08 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240805233326/http://olympic.ca/2019/02/08/faq-what-are-the-olympic-games/ |archive-date=2024-08-05 |url-status=live |access-date=20 February 2025}}</ref> A total of 5,338 athletes representing 83 [[National Olympic Committee|National Olympic Committees]] (NOCs) participated,<ref name="IOC 1960 Rome">{{cite web |title=Rome 1960 Summer Olympics – Athletes, Medals & Results |url=https://www.olympics.com/en/olympic-games/rome-1960 |website=[[International Olympic Committee]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250106170233/https://olympics.com/en/olympic-games/rome-1960 |archive-date=2025-01-06 |url-status=live |access-date=February 20, 2025}}</ref> which included five teams making their Olympic debut at the Summer Games: the [[British West Indies at the 1960 Summer Olympics|British West Indies]],<ref name="BFI">{{cite web |title=West Indies Federation (WIF) |url=https://www.olympedia.org/countries/WIF |website=[[Olympedia]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250207231911/https://www.olympedia.org/countries/WIF |archive-date=2025-02-07 |url-status=live |access-date=20 February 2025}}</ref> [[Morocco at the 1960 Summer Olympics|Morocco]],<ref name="Morocco IOC">{{cite web |title=Morocco – Profile |url=https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/morocco |website=[[International Olympic Committee]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241006043812/https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/morocco |archive-date=2024-10-06 |url-status=dead |access-date=2024-12-30}}</ref> [[San Marino at the 1960 Summer Olympics|San Marino]],<ref name="San Marino IOC">{{cite web |title=San Marino – Profile |url=https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/san-marino |website=[[International Olympic Committee]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241006044206/https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/san-marino |archive-date=October 6, 2024 |url-status=dead |access-date=2024-12-30 }}</ref> [[Sudan at the 1960 Summer Olympics|Sudan]],<ref name="Sudan IOC">{{cite web |title=Sudan – Profile |url=https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/sudan |website=[[International Olympic Committee]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241006044524/https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/sudan |archive-date=2024-10-06 |url-status=dead |access-date=2024-12-30}}</ref> and [[Tunisia at the 1960 Summer Olympics|Tunisia]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Tunisia – Profile |url=https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/tunisia |website=[[International Olympic Committee]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241006044505/https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/tunisia |archive-date=2024-10-06 |url-status=dead |access-date=December 20, 2024}}</ref> The games featured 150 events in 17 [[Olympic sports|sports]] across 23 disciplines.<ref name="IOC 1960 Rome" /><ref>{{cite web |title=Rome 1960 |url=https://www.olympics.com.au/games/rome-1960/ |website=[[Australian Olympic Committee]] |access-date=20 February 2025 |language=en-AU |archive-date=September 17, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240917195852/https://www.olympics.com.au/games/rome-1960/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Rao |first1=Rakesh |title=Games in the time of turmoil |url=https://sportstar.thehindu.com/rio-2016-olympics/olympics-history/games-in-the-time-of-turmoil/article8912316.ece |website=[[The Hindu]] |access-date=20 February 2025 |language=en |date=28 July 2016 |archive-date=June 25, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240625093410/https://sportstar.thehindu.com/rio-2016-olympics/olympics-history/games-in-the-time-of-turmoil/article8912316.ece |url-status=live }}</ref>

Athletes representing 44 NOCs received at least one medal, with 23 NOCs winning at least one gold medal.<ref name="IOC medal table" /> The [[Soviet Union]] won the most overall medals, with 103, and the most gold medals, with 43.<ref name="IOC medal table" /> The [[British West Indies at the 1960 Summer Olympics|British West Indies]],<ref name="BFI" /> [[Republic of China at the 1960 Summer Olympics|Republic of China]] (now competing as Chinese Taipei),<ref name="Chinese Taipei IOC">{{cite web |title=Chinese Taipei – Profile |url=https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/chinese-taipei |website=[[International Olympic Committee]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241204141508/https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/chinese-taipei |archive-date=December 4, 2024 |url-status=dead |access-date=2024-12-30 }}</ref> [[Ethiopia at the 1960 Summer Olympics|Ethiopia]],<ref name="Ethiopia IOC">{{cite web |title=Ethiopia – Profile |url=https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/ethiopia |website=[[International Olympic Committee]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241006043125/https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/ethiopia |archive-date=2024-10-06 |url-status=dead |access-date=2024-12-30}}</ref> [[Ghana at the 1960 Summer Olympics|Ghana]],<ref name="Ghana IOC">{{cite web |title=Ghana – Profile |url=https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/ghana |website=[[International Olympic Committee]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241202160508/https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/ghana |archive-date=2024-12-02 |url-status=dead |access-date=2024-12-30}}</ref> [[Iraq at the 1960 Summer Olympics|Iraq]],<ref name="Iraq IOC">{{cite web |title=Iraq – Profile |url=https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/iraq |website=[[International Olympic Committee]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241006043303/https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/iraq |archive-date=2024-10-06 |url-status=dead |access-date=2024-12-30}}</ref> Morocco,<ref name="Morocco IOC" /> and [[Singapore at the 1960 Summer Olympics|Singapore]] won their first Summer Olympic medals of any kind,<ref name="Singapore IOC">{{cite web |title=Singapore – Profile |url=https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/singapore |website=[[International Olympic Committee]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241006044322/https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/singapore |archive-date=2024-10-06 |url-status=dead |access-date=2024-12-30}}</ref> with Ethiopia and Pakistan winning their first gold medals.<ref name="Ethiopia IOC" /><ref name="Pakistan IOC">{{cite web |title=Pakistan – Profile |url=https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/pakistan |website=[[International Olympic Committee]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241006043907/https://olympics.com/en/paris-2024/profile/pakistan |archive-date=2024-10-06 |url-status=dead |access-date=2024-12-30}}</ref>

Among individual participants, Soviet gymnast [[Boris Shakhlin]] won the most gold medals, with four, and the most total medals, with seven (four gold, two silver, and one bronze).<ref>{{cite web |title=1960 Roma Summer Games |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/summer/1960/ |website=[[Sports Reference]] |access-date=February 20, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200417040632/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/summer/1960/ |archive-date=April 17, 2020 |url-status=dead}}</ref> Italian fencer [[Edoardo Mangiarotti]] secured two medals at the 1960 games (one gold, one silver) and became the record holder for the most Olympic medals won, with 13 medals in total (six gold, five silver, two bronze).<ref name="Mangiarotti 1">{{Cite web |date=16 July 2012 |title=Edoardo Mangiarotti |url=https://www.thetimes.com/article/edoardo-mangiarotti-5dncnt7qv3b |url-access=subscription |access-date=20 February 2025 |website=[[The Times]] |language=en |archive-date=July 30, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240730122806/https://www.thetimes.com/article/edoardo-mangiarotti-5dncnt7qv3b |url-status=live }}</ref> Mangiarotti had won medals at the 1936 (one gold), 1948 (two silver, one bronze), 1952 (two gold, two silver), and 1956 games (two gold, one bronze) prior to 1960.<ref name="Mangiarotti 2">{{cite web |title=Edoardo Mangiarotti |url=https://www.olympedia.org/athletes/22677 |website=[[Olympedia]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250114190810/https://www.olympedia.org/athletes/22677 |archive-date=2025-01-14 |url-status=live |access-date=20 February 2025}}</ref>

== Medal table ==
[[File:Edoardo Mangiarotti.jpg|thumb|right|alt=Edoardo Mangiarotti in a fencing pose with a rapier and no mask on.|Italian fencer [[Edoardo Mangiarotti]] became the Olympian with the most total medals ever when he won his twelfth and thirteenth medals at the 1960 games. He had won 11 medals at Olympic Games prior to these games.<ref name="Mangiarotti 1" /><ref name="Mangiarotti 2" />]]
[[File:Rhadi Ben Abdesselam, Abebe Bikila 1960.jpg|thumb|right|alt=Abebe Bikila and Rhadi Ben Abdesselam standing with an arm around each other and their Olympic medals hanging from their necks. Both shown from about the waste up.|Ethiopian runner [[Abebe Bikila]] (right) and Moroccan runner [[Rhadi Ben Abdesselam]] won their countries' first Olympic medals in the [[Athletics at the 1960 Summer Olympics – Men's marathon|men's marathon]]. Bikila finished first and Ben Abdesselam finished second.<ref name="Ethiopia IOC" /><ref name="Morocco IOC" />]] 
The medal table is based on information provided by the [[International Olympic Committee]] (IOC) and is consistent with IOC conventional sorting in its published medal tables. The table uses the [[Olympic medal table]] sorting method. By default, the table is ordered by the number of gold medals the athletes from a nation have won, where a nation is an entity represented by a NOC. The number of silver medals is taken into consideration next and then the number of bronze medals.<ref>{{cite web |title=Olympic medal table: USA beat China to top spot at Paris 2024 |url=https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/olympics/olympics-2024-medal-table-count-paris-b2580716.html |website=[[The Independent]] | date=August 11, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240812015233/https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/olympics/olympics-2024-medal-table-count-paris-b2594580.html |archive-date=August 12, 2024 |url-status=live |last1=Ostlere |first1=Lawrence |access-date=August 12, 2024 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=A Medal Count That Adds Up To Little |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2008/08/19/sports/olympics/19araton.html |website=[[The New York Times]] | date=August 18, 2008 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230321004238/https://www.nytimes.com/2008/08/19/sports/olympics/19araton.html |archive-date=March 21, 2023 |url-status=live |last1=Araton |first1=Harvey |url-access=subscription |access-date=July 25, 2024 }}</ref> If teams are still tied, equal ranking is given and they are listed alphabetically by their [[List of IOC country codes|IOC country code]].<ref>{{cite web |title=What happens if two countries are tied in the Olympic medal table? Tiebreaker rules explained |url=https://en.as.com/olympic_games/what-happens-if-two-countries-are-tied-in-the-olympic-medal-table-tiebreaker-rules-explained-n/ |website=[[Diario AS]] |date=August 10, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240811152350/https://en.as.com/olympic_games/what-happens-if-two-countries-are-tied-in-the-olympic-medal-table-tiebreaker-rules-explained-n/ |archive-date=August 11, 2024 |url-status=live |last1=Cons |first1=Roddy |access-date=August 11, 2024 |language=en-us }}</ref>

Events in [[Boxing at the 1980 Summer Olympics|boxing]] resulted in bronze medals being awarded to each of the competitors who lost their semi-final matches, as opposed to them taking part in a [[Third place playoff|third place tiebreaker]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Explained: Two bronze medals are awarded in the Olympics boxing competition |url=https://olympics.com/en/news/why-two-bronze-medals-boxing |website=[[International Olympic Committee]] | date=August 1, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230328143327/https://olympics.com/en/news/why-two-bronze-medals-boxing |archive-date=March 28, 2023 |url-status=live |last1=Ansari |first1=Aarish |access-date=August 2, 2024 }}</ref>

In [[Athletics at the 1960 Summer Olympics – Women's high jump|women's high jump]], a two-way tie for second resulted in two silvers and no bronze medals being awarded.<ref>{{cite web |title=Rome 1960 high jump women Results – Olympic athletics |url=https://www.olympics.com/en/olympic-games/rome-1960/results/athletics/high-jump-women |website=[[International Olympic Committee]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241126150437/https://olympics.com/en/olympic-games/rome-1960/results/athletics/high-jump-women |archive-date=2024-11-26 |url-status=live |access-date=20 February 2025}}</ref> In the [[Gymnastics at the 1960 Summer Olympics – Men's pommel horse|men's pommel horse]] and [[Gymnastics at the 1960 Summer Olympics – Men's vault|men's vault]], two-way ties for first resulted in two gold and no silver medals being awarded in each event.<ref>{{cite web |title=Rome 1960 pommel men Results – Olympic gymnastics-artistic |url=https://www.olympics.com/en/olympic-games/rome-1960/results/gymnastics-artistic/pommel-horse-men |website=[[International Olympic Committee]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211117014611/https://olympics.com/en/olympic-games/rome-1960/results/gymnastics-artistic/pommel-horse-men |archive-date=2021-11-17 |url-status=live |access-date=20 February 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Rome 1960 vault men Results – Olympic gymnastics-artistic |url=https://www.olympics.com/en/olympic-games/rome-1960/results/gymnastics-artistic/vault-men |website=[[International Olympic Committee]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211117074222/https://olympics.com/en/olympic-games/rome-1960/results/gymnastics-artistic/vault-men |archive-date=2021-11-17 |url-status=live |access-date=20 February 2025}}</ref> Lastly, in the [[Gymnastics at the 1960 Summer Olympics – Men's rings|men's ring event]], there was a two-way tie for third which resulted in two bronze medals being awarded.<ref>{{cite web |title=Rome 1960 rings men Results – Olympic gymnastics-artistic |url=https://www.olympics.com/en/olympic-games/rome-1960/results/gymnastics-artistic/rings-men |website=[[International Olympic Committee]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211116185715/https://olympics.com/en/olympic-games/rome-1960/results/gymnastics-artistic/rings-men |archive-date=2021-11-16 |url-status=live |access-date=20 February 2025}}</ref>
